item.title: Get Your Hands On the Most Beautiful Saree At This Saree Store In The Nooks Of Shankar Market!
item.description: If you live upon the Chanderi, Cotton and similar fabrics, then you ought to head to this place rn! Jain Saree Centre in the heart of Delhi is a house for beautiful sarees you wonder to buy one day. As the name suggests, the shop has an aesthetically amah-zing collection of sarees.

item.title: Hog On Piping Hot Home-Style Keema Mutton With Unlimited Rotis At This Shop In Sadar Bazar
item.description: If you're a non-vegetarian, you've surely encountered those insane cravings when ma used to cook mutton curry with the intoxicating aroma of desi ghee. It's time to revive the homely charm by cramming down authentic keema mutton curry at this dainty roadside meat counter in Sadar Bazaar.

item.title: Get Ready To Catch Shabana Azmi Live On Stage At ‘Spotlight’ on 27th July, Siri Fort Auditorium
item.description: Delhi is home to one of the finest theatre artists in the country. *drum rolls* Delhi Theatre Festival’s ‘Spotlight’ again is all set to introduce Dilliwaalas with its theatre show ‘Broken Images’ starring the magnificent Shabana Azmi.

item.title: In Love With Quoted Tees? Shop The Quirkiest T-Shirt Dress From This Store In Shahpur Jat!
item.description: We know that your eyes keep on finding flowy dresses, PJ Pants, and skirts. So, we are taking you right at the paradise of breathable-clothing place with a twist of quirkiness. Red Sister Blue, a mini boutique in Shahpur Jat has a unique variety in Khadi! So let's head to the house of breathable collection.

item.title: Gorge On This Lip Smacking Atta Chicken At This Place In Udyog Vihar
item.description: All the chicken lovers in the house head over to Unplugged Courtyard to savor an absolutely crazzyyy dish made out of chicken. Yes, this place plates up the finger licking Atta Chicken that is just all the more healthy and yummy fo'sho! Read on!

item.title: Listen Up, CheesyHeads! This Place Serves The Cheesiest Hot Dog In Town!
item.description: This time we've come with the cheesiest Hot dog and Burger in town. Imagine that desi burger fried in butter yet full of cheese, stuffed with authentic spices. Having foodgasms? Well wipe off your mouths and listen up for Vijay Hotdog Burger near Vijay Chowk.

item.title: 10 Lakh Trees To Be Planted In 1 day! Gear Up To Be A Part Of The Grand Plantation Drive
item.description: It’s time to vouch for a cleaner tomorrow by taking part in the ‘DilliKaCampaign’, the grand mass plantation movement taking place on 28th July with the joint initiative of about twenty peeps from the nook and cranny of the city.

item.title: Listen Up Coffee Lovers! Show-Off Your Bond With Coffee By Popping-Up At This Newbie In Town!
item.description: Does your heart live upon that cup of coffee? If your day starts with that cup of joy then we're calling you loud. Come and drop by this brand new cafe in town for their amah-zing variety of coffee. Oh yes, Cofee bond in Udyog Vihar will let you bond your yearning with that cup of delights.

item.title: Techies And CAs! Time To Buck Up Coz Noida Metro Is Hiring
item.description: Shout-out to all engineers, CAs, graduates and ITI pass students! There's something awesome y'all gotta hear up. Noida Metro Rail Corporation (NMRC) has rolled out 199 vacancies for multiple technical and accountancy posts.
